scenes.name: 电梯里的寒暄 · 搬来一个月
scenes.setting: 你搬进新公寓一个月，今天在电梯里撞见了邻居。

lines.en: Morning! Nasty weather today, isn't it?
lines.zh: 早啊！今天天气真糟糕，是吧？
lines.note: 用反义疑问句开启闲聊是英语世界的通用做法，对方只需应一声。

lines.en: Tell me about it. I got soaked walking here.
lines.zh: 可不是嘛，我走过来全身都湿了。
lines.note: Tell me about it 不是「跟我说说」，而是强烈赞同＝「太对了」。

lines.en: Are you new to the building? I don't think we've met.
lines.zh: 你是新搬来的吧？我们好像没见过。

lines.en: I moved in last month, unit 302. I'm Wen.
lines.zh: 我上个月搬来的，302。我叫 Wen。

lines.en: Nice to meet you, Wen. I'm Dan, 405. How's the flat working out?
lines.zh: 幸会，Wen。我是 Dan，405。房子住着怎么样？
lines.note: How's … working out 是问「结果如何／顺不顺利」，比 How is it 更自然。

lines.en: So far so good, apart from the noise from the street.
lines.zh: 到目前还好，就是街上有点吵。
lines.note: apart from＝除了。这个短语一出，抱怨也显得客气。

lines.en: Yeah, that takes some getting used to. I'm on the fourth floor if you ever need anything.
lines.zh: 是啊，这得适应一阵。有需要就上四楼找我。
lines.note: take some getting used to＝需要时间适应，固定搭配。

lines.en: That's kind of you. See you around!
lines.zh: 你人真好。回头见！

branch.task: 邻居提出一件具体的邀请，答应或婉拒，别让话掉在地上

prompt.en: If the noise gets too much, we've got a group chat about it. Want me to add you?
prompt.zh: 要是吵得受不了，我们有个群在说这事儿。要加你进来吗？

say.en: That'd be handy, thanks.

react.en: Great, I'll send you the link. I'm on the fourth floor too.
react.zh: 好，我把链接发你。我也住四楼。

say.en: Maybe later. I'm still settling in.

react.en: No rush. I'm on the fourth floor if you change your mind.
react.zh: 不着急，改主意了就上四楼找我。

phrases.en: That takes some getting used to.

scenes.name: 理发店剪头 · 修剪一下
scenes.setting: 你头发长了两个月，只想修整齐，不想换发型。

lines.en: What are we doing today?
lines.zh: 今天怎么剪？

lines.en: Just a trim. Short on the sides, a bit off the top.
lines.zh: 就想修一下。两侧短一点，上面稍微剪短。
lines.note: trim 是「修剪」，不是「剪很多」；说 just a trim 理发师就不会下手太重。

lines.en: How short on the sides?
lines.zh: 两侧要多短？

lines.en: A number two, but not down to the skin.
lines.zh: 二号，但别推到露头皮。
lines.note: number two 是推剪的限位梳号数，数字越小越短。

lines.en: Got it. Shall I leave the front longer?
lines.zh: 明白。前面留长一点吗？

lines.en: Yes, just tidy it up.
lines.zh: 对，就修整齐。

lines.en: Do you want a wash as well?
lines.zh: 要洗一下吗？

lines.en: No, thanks. Just the cut.
lines.zh: 不用，就剪。

lines.en: That will be twenty-two.
lines.zh: 一共二十二。

branch.task: 工具出了问题，你要接受一个替代方案

prompt.en: The clippers just died. Scissors only, if that is all right.
prompt.zh: 推子坏了。只能用剪刀，行吗？

say.en: Scissors are fine, just keep it short.

react.en: Then I will go slow and even.

say.en: How much longer will it take?

react.en: Fifteen minutes more, no extra charge.

phrases.en: Short on the sides, a bit off the top.
phrases.zh: 两侧短一点，上面稍微剪短。

scenes.name: 洗衣店送洗 · 洗加叠
scenes.setting: 你攒了两周的衣服，想一次性解决。

lines.en: Hi, how much for a wash and fold?
lines.zh: 你好，洗加叠多少钱？
lines.note: wash and fold 是洗衣店最便宜的服务：洗完叠好，不管熨。

lines.en: Twelve a load, ready tomorrow.
lines.zh: 一桶十二，明天取。

lines.en: Can I get it by tonight?
lines.zh: 今晚能取吗？

lines.en: Same day is eighteen, before six.
lines.zh: 当天取十八，六点前来拿。

lines.en: Do that. And this shirt needs dry cleaning.
lines.zh: 就当天。这件衬衫要干洗。

lines.en: That is six more. Any stains?
lines.zh: 再加六块。有污渍吗？

lines.en: One on the collar. I tried soap and it did not help.
lines.zh: 领子上有一块。我用肥皂试过，没用。

lines.en: We will have a go. It may not come out fully.
lines.zh: 我们试试。可能去不干净。

branch.task: 对方说洗不掉，你要决定接受还是换方案

prompt.en: Honestly, that stain looks set in. We probably cannot lift it.
prompt.zh: 说实话，这污渍像是定住了。我们大概洗不掉。

say.en: Try anyway. I have nothing to lose.
say.zh: 还是试试吧，反正也不亏。

react.en: We will. If it fades, we will call you first.
react.zh: 好。要是洗淡了我们先打给您。

say.en: Then just clean the rest of it.
say.zh: 那就把其它地方洗干净。

react.en: Understood. Same price, I am afraid.

phrases.en: How much for a wash and fold?

scenes.setting: 你给家里寄一箱东西，第一次用这边的邮局。

lines.zh: 要，签收的那种。

lines.zh: 地址写中文吗？

lines.en: Both languages, if you can. It helps at the other end.
lines.zh: 能写双语最好。对方那边好处理。

scenes.setting: 你刚搬来一个月，房东提醒你尽快开本地账户。

lines.en: I would like to open an account.
lines.zh: 我想开个账户。

lines.en: Are you a resident here?
lines.zh: 您是本地居民吗？

lines.en: Yes, I moved here last month.
lines.zh: 是，我上个月搬来的。

lines.en: I need your ID and proof of address.
lines.zh: 需要您的证件和地址证明。

lines.en: I have a utility bill. Is that enough?
lines.zh: 我有水电费账单。够吗？

lines.en: It is, as long as it is less than three months old.
lines.zh: 够，只要是三个月内的。

lines.en: Good. And can I set up online banking today?
lines.zh: 好。今天能开通网银吗？

lines.en: You can. The card comes in five working days.
lines.zh: 可以。卡五个工作日内寄到。

scenes.name: 药店买药 · 喉咙痛
scenes.setting: 你喉咙痛了三天，不想为这点事去诊所排队。

lines.en: Do you have anything for a sore throat?
lines.zh: 有治喉咙痛的吗？

lines.en: Is it dry, or with a cough?
lines.zh: 是干痛，还是带咳嗽？

lines.en: Dry, and it hurts when I swallow.
lines.zh: 干痛，咽东西就疼。

lines.en: These lozenges help. One every four hours.
lines.zh: 这种含片有用。四小时一片。

lines.en: Can I take them with ibuprofen?
lines.zh: 能和布洛芬一起吃吗？

lines.en: You can, but leave two hours between them.
lines.zh: 可以，但两种药隔两小时。
lines.note: leave two hours between 是「错开两小时」，用药安全的关键句。

lines.en: Got it. Do I need a prescription?
lines.zh: 明白。需要处方吗？

lines.en: Not for these. If it lasts more than a week, see a doctor.
lines.zh: 这些不用。要是超过一周，去看医生。

branch.task: 对方推荐替代品，你要判断能不能用

scenes.name: 药店买药 · 处方药
scenes.setting: 你要的药必须有处方。

lines.en: Do you have anything for a sore throat?
lines.zh: 有治喉咙痛的吗？

lines.en: Is it dry, or with a cough?
lines.zh: 是干痛，还是带咳嗽？

lines.en: Dry, and it hurts when I swallow.
lines.zh: 干痛，咽东西就疼。

lines.en: These lozenges help. One every four hours.
lines.zh: 这种含片有用。四小时一片。

lines.en: Can I take them with ibuprofen?
lines.zh: 能和布洛芬一起吃吗？

lines.en: You can, but leave two hours between them.
lines.zh: 可以，但两种药隔两小时。
lines.note: leave two hours between 是「错开两小时」，用药安全的关键句。

lines.en: This one says prescription only. Can you help?
lines.zh: 这个写着只凭处方。能想想办法吗？

lines.en: Not without one. A walk-in clinic can issue it today.
lines.zh: 没处方不行。急诊诊所今天就能开。

scenes.name: 找邻居说噪音 · 音乐太大声
scenes.setting: 楼上十一点还在放低音很重的音乐，你第二天六点要起。

lines.en: Hi, sorry to bother you. The music is quite loud.
lines.zh: 你好，不好意思打扰。音乐有点大声。
lines.note: 先说 sorry to bother you，再提问题 —— 直接说太吵容易开战。

lines.en: Oh, I did not realise. Is it coming through the wall?
lines.zh: 哦，我没意识到。是隔着墙传过去的吗？

lines.en: A bit. I work early, so I am in bed by ten.
lines.zh: 有一点。我上班早，十点就睡。

lines.en: Sorry about that. I will turn it down.
lines.zh: 抱歉。我调小。

lines.en: Thanks. And one more thing, the bin bags in the hall.
lines.zh: 谢谢。还有件事，走廊里的垃圾袋。

lines.en: Are they in the way?
lines.zh: 挡路了吗？

lines.en: They have been there since Monday. The whole floor smells.
lines.zh: 周一就在那儿了。整层都有味道。

lines.en: Fair enough. I will take them down tonight.
lines.zh: 说得对。我今晚拿下去。

branch.task: 对方反问，你要把话说清楚又不激化

prompt.en: It is only ten. Is it really that loud?
prompt.zh: 才十点。真有那么吵吗？

say.en: The bass carries. I can hear it in my bedroom.
say.zh: 低音传得远。我卧室里都能听见。

react.en: Fair. I will move the speaker off the wall.
react.zh: 有道理。我把音箱从墙边挪开。

say.en: It is not the volume, it is the hour. I am up at six.
say.zh: 不是音量，是时间。我六点起。

react.en: Understood. Weeknights I will keep it low.

phrases.en: I work early, so I am in bed by ten.

scenes.name: 快递送上门 · 上班不在家
scenes.setting: 你在开会，手机静音，快递员打了两次没通。

lines.en: Delivery. I have a parcel for 302.
lines.zh: 快递。302 有个包裹。

lines.en: That is me. Could you leave it by the door?
lines.zh: 是我。能放门口吗？

lines.en: I need a signature. Are you home now?
lines.zh: 要签收。你现在在家吗？

lines.en: I am at work. Can you come back after six?
lines.zh: 我在上班。六点后能再来吗？

lines.en: My shift ends at five. It would be tomorrow.
lines.zh: 我五点下班。那得明天了。

lines.en: Then could you leave it with a neighbour?
lines.zh: 那能放在邻居那儿吗？

lines.en: Number 304 took one for you last time. Shall I try there?
lines.zh: 304 上次帮您收过。我去那儿试试？

lines.en: Perfect. Thanks a lot.
lines.zh: 太好了。多谢。

scenes.name: 咖啡店点单 · 赶时间的早晨
scenes.setting: 工作日的早晨，街角咖啡店排着队。你只想快点拿到咖啡，别迟到。

lines.en: Hi there! What can I get started for you?
lines.zh: 你好！想喝点什么？
lines.note: get started for you 是美国咖啡店的固定问法，字面是「开始给你做」。不是问你要不要开始。

lines.en: Could I get a large latte, please?
lines.zh: 我要一杯大杯拿铁，谢谢。
lines.note: 点单说 Could I get… 比 I want… 礼貌得多，也不用想 Would you… 后面接什么。

lines.en: Sure. Hot or iced?
lines.zh: 好的。热的还是冰的？

lines.en: Iced, please. And could you make it with oat milk?
lines.zh: 冰的。能换成燕麦奶吗？

lines.en: We can. That'll be fifty cents extra, is that okay?
lines.zh: 可以。要加五毛钱，行吗？
lines.note: That'll be + 金额，是店员报价格式，听到就知道该掏钱了。

lines.en: That's fine. Oh, and could I get a blueberry muffin too?
lines.zh: 没问题。对了，再来一个蓝莓麦芬。

lines.en: For here or to go?
lines.zh: 在这儿喝还是带走？
lines.note: 英式说 eat in or takeaway，意思一样。

lines.en: To go, please. Can I pay by card?
lines.zh: 带走。可以刷卡吗？

lines.en: Of course. What name should I put on the cup?
lines.zh: 当然。杯子上写什么名字？

lines.en: Wen. W-E-N. Thanks a lot.
lines.zh: Wen，W-E-N。多谢。

scenes.name: 咖啡店点单 · 名字总被写错
scenes.setting: 你的名字在这家店被写错过三次，这次你决定直接拼出来。

lines.en: Hi there! What can I get started for you?
lines.zh: 你好！想喝点什么？
lines.note: get started for you 是美国咖啡店的固定问法，字面是「开始给你做」。不是问你要不要开始。

lines.en: Could I get a large latte, please?
lines.zh: 我要一杯大杯拿铁，谢谢。
lines.note: 点单说 Could I get… 比 I want… 礼貌得多，也不用想 Would you… 后面接什么。

lines.en: Sure. Hot or iced?
lines.zh: 好的。热的还是冰的？

lines.en: Iced, please. And could you make it with oat milk?
lines.zh: 冰的。能换成燕麦奶吗？

lines.en: We can. That'll be fifty cents extra, is that okay?
lines.zh: 可以。要加五毛钱，行吗？
lines.note: That'll be + 金额，是店员报价格式，听到就知道该掏钱了。

lines.en: That's fine. Oh, and could I get a blueberry muffin too?
lines.zh: 没问题。对了，再来一个蓝莓麦芬。

lines.en: For here or to go?
lines.zh: 在这儿喝还是带走？
lines.note: 英式说 eat in or takeaway，意思一样。

lines.en: To go, please. Can I pay by card?
lines.zh: 带走。可以刷卡吗？

lines.en: Of course. What name should I put on the cup?
lines.zh: 当然。杯子上写什么名字？

lines.en: It is Wen. W-E-N. Short for Wenjing.
lines.zh: Wen，W-E-N，是 Wenjing 的简称。
lines.note: 报名字时一个字母一个字母说，是最省事的救场动作。

scenes.name: 餐厅点菜 · 先说忌口
scenes.setting: 你和朋友坐在餐厅里，菜还没点，你有坚果过敏。

lines.en: Are you ready to order, or would you like a few more minutes?
lines.zh: 可以点菜了吗，还是再看一会儿？

lines.en: A few more minutes, please. What do you recommend?
lines.zh: 再看一会儿。有什么推荐吗？

lines.en: The grilled salmon is very popular tonight, and the mushroom soup is a house special.
lines.zh: 今晚烤三文鱼很受欢迎，蘑菇汤是本店招牌。

lines.en: I'll have the salmon. Could I get the sauce on the side?
lines.zh: 那我要三文鱼。酱汁能单独放吗？
lines.note: on the side＝另装在小碟里，不加在菜上。点菜高频。

lines.en: Of course. And to drink?
lines.zh: 当然。喝点什么？

lines.en: Just still water, thanks. Oh, I'm allergic to nuts, does this dish contain any?
lines.zh: 白水就行。对了，我对坚果过敏，这道菜里有吗？
lines.note: allergic to + 名词。过敏在国外餐厅是必须能说清的一句。

lines.en: Let me check with the kitchen and I'll let you know.
lines.zh: 我去问问后厨，然后告诉您。

lines.en: Thank you. Excuse me, could we get the bill? And could we split it?
lines.zh: 谢谢。不好意思，麻烦结账。可以分开付吗？

lines.en: Certainly. Card or cash?
lines.zh: 可以。刷卡还是现金？

lines.en: Card. Everything was delicious, thank you.
lines.zh: 刷卡。菜很好吃，谢谢。

scenes.name: 看医生 · 喉咙痛四天
scenes.setting: 喉咙痛了四天，越来越严重，你去了社区诊所。

lines.en: Come on in and have a seat. What brings you in today?
lines.zh: 进来坐吧。今天哪里不舒服？
lines.note: What brings you in 是医生的标准开场，字面是「什么把你带来的」。

lines.en: I've had a sore throat for about four days, and it's getting worse.
lines.zh: 我喉咙痛了四天左右，越来越严重。
lines.note: 病程用现在完成时：I've had … for four days。说 I have 会被理解为刚开始。

lines.en: Any fever or cough?
lines.zh: 发烧或咳嗽吗？

lines.en: A slight fever last night, thirty-eight degrees. No cough.
lines.zh: 昨晚有点低烧，三十八度。没咳嗽。

lines.en: Let me take a look. It's quite red. Are you allergic to penicillin?
lines.zh: 我看一下。挺红的。你对青霉素过敏吗？

lines.en: I don't think so, but I'm not completely sure.
lines.zh: 应该不过敏，但我不太确定。

lines.en: Then I'll prescribe something milder. Take it three times a day after meals.
lines.zh: 那我开点温和的。一天三次，饭后吃。

lines.en: How long will it take to feel better?
lines.zh: 多久能好？

lines.en: You should see a difference in two or three days. If the fever comes back, come straight back in.
lines.zh: 两三天就该有起色。要是又发烧，直接回来找我。

lines.en: Thank you, doctor. I really appreciate it.
lines.zh: 谢谢医生，太感谢了。

branch.task: 医生要先做检查，问清楚你真正关心的那件事

prompt.zh: 在检查之前，我想先做个快速化验，可以吗？

react.en: It is, don't worry. Now, are you allergic to penicillin?
react.zh: 能报，别担心。你对青霉素过敏吗？

say.en: Sure. How long will the results take?

react.en: About twenty minutes. Meanwhile, are you allergic to penicillin?
react.zh: 大概二十分钟。对了，你对青霉素过敏吗？

phrases.en: I've had a sore throat for four days.

scenes.setting: 你喝冰水时右边一颗牙刺痛，拖了两个月。

lines.en: When did you last see a dentist?
lines.zh: 上次看牙是什么时候？

lines.en: About two years ago. One tooth hurts when I drink cold water.
lines.zh: 大概两年前。有一颗牙喝冷水会疼。

lines.en: Let me take an X-ray. Does it hurt right now?
lines.zh: 我拍个片子。现在疼吗？

lines.en: Only with cold. Not with hot.
lines.zh: 只有冷的疼。热的没事。
lines.note: 冷疼热不疼，通常是龋齿；反过来可能是牙髓问题 —— 医生就靠这个区分。

lines.en: There is a small cavity. We can fill it today.
lines.zh: 有个小蛀洞。今天就能补。

lines.en: Will it hurt?
lines.zh: 会疼吗？

lines.en: We will numb it. You will feel pressure, not pain.
lines.zh: 会打麻药。你会觉得有压力，不疼。

lines.en: How much will it cost?
lines.zh: 要多少钱？

lines.en: A hundred and twenty, including the X-ray.
lines.zh: 一百二，含拍片。

lines.en: All right. Let us do it.
lines.zh: 好。那就补吧。

branch.task: 医生说情况比预想复杂，你要决定今天做还是改天

react.en: Two visits, and about four hundred.

say.en: Can we start with the filling and see?

react.en: We can, but there is a chance it fails.

phrases.en: It hurts when I drink cold water.

scenes.name: 急诊处理伤口 · 玻璃划伤
scenes.setting: 你打碎了一个杯子，捡碎片时划开手掌。

lines.en: What seems to be the problem?
lines.zh: 哪里不舒服？

lines.en: I cut my hand on a glass. It will not stop bleeding.
lines.zh: 我的手被玻璃划了。血止不住。

lines.en: Let me see. How long ago?
lines.zh: 我看看。多久之前？

lines.en: Twenty minutes. I have been pressing it with a towel.
lines.zh: 二十分钟。我一直用毛巾按着。

lines.en: You need stitches. Are you on any medication?
lines.zh: 需要缝针。你在吃什么药吗？

lines.en: Just aspirin, one a day.
lines.zh: 只有阿司匹林，一天一片。

lines.en: That thins the blood, so expect a bit more bleeding. Any allergies?
lines.zh: 那会稀释血液，可能会多流一点。有过敏吗？

lines.en: None that I know of.
lines.zh: 据我所知没有。

lines.en: Good. We will numb the area and close it with four stitches.
lines.zh: 好。我们先麻醉，再缝四针。

branch.task: 护士问你的用药情况，你要给准确信息

prompt.en: Do you take anything else? Even supplements count.
prompt.zh: 还在吃别的吗？保健品也算。

say.en: Fish oil and vitamin D, nothing prescription.
say.zh: 鱼油和维生素 D，没有处方药。

react.en: Noted. We will keep pressure on it.

say.en: I took ibuprofen this morning, about four hours ago.
say.zh: 今天早上吃了布洛芬，大概四小时前。

react.en: Good to know. That also affects bleeding.
react.zh: 知道了。那也会影响出血。

phrases.en: I have been pressing it with a towel.

scenes.name: 医疗保险理赔 · 牙科理赔
scenes.setting: 你自费补了牙，想把钱报回来一部分。

lines.en: I need to make a claim for a dental visit.
lines.zh: 我要申请一笔牙科理赔。

lines.en: Do you have the invoice and the receipt?
lines.zh: 有发票和收据吗？

lines.en: I have both, and the treatment notes.
lines.zh: 两样都有，还有治疗记录。

lines.en: Was it an emergency or planned treatment?
lines.zh: 是急诊还是计划内治疗？

lines.en: Planned. I have the pre-approval email from March.
lines.zh: 计划内。我有三月的预审批邮件。
lines.note: pre-approval 是事先审批，有计划治疗一定要先拿，否则可能不报。

lines.en: Then it is covered at seventy percent, up to eight hundred a year.
lines.zh: 那报七成，每年上限八百。

lines.en: I have already used three hundred this year.
lines.zh: 我今年已经用了三百。

lines.en: Then five hundred of cover is left. Send the documents and we will process it.
lines.zh: 那还剩五百额度。把材料寄来我们处理。

branch.task: 额度不够，你要判断剩下的怎么处理

prompt.en: Then only five hundred is left, and the treatment was six hundred.
prompt.zh: 那只剩五百额度，治疗花了六百。

say.en: So I pay the last hundred myself?

react.en: Exactly. We settle it after the claim.

say.en: Can it go against next year?

react.en: Only if the treatment happens next year.
react.zh: 只有治疗发生在明年才行。

phrases.en: I need to make a claim.
Was it planned or an emergency?

lines.zh: 是急诊还是计划内治疗？

lines.en: Planned. I have the pre-approval email from March.
lines.zh: 计划内。我有三月的预审批邮件。

say.en: Can it go against next year?

react.en: Only if the treatment happens next year.
react.zh: 只有治疗发生在明年才行。

phrases.en: I need to make a claim.

lines.zh: 这些一个人扛很重。现在最需要什么？

scenes.name: 退换货 · 拉链坏了
scenes.setting: 上周买的外套拉链坏了，你带着电子收据回到店里。

lines.en: Hi, how can I help you today?
lines.zh: 你好，需要什么帮助？

lines.en: I bought this jacket last week, but the zip is broken. I'd like to return it.
lines.zh: 我上周买了这件外套，拉链坏了。我想退掉。

lines.en: Do you have the receipt with you?
lines.zh: 您带收据了吗？

lines.en: I have it on my phone. Will that do?
lines.zh: 手机里有电子收据。这样可以吗？
lines.note: Will that do? ＝这个行不行？口语里极常用，比 Is that okay 更地道。

lines.en: That's fine. Would you like a refund or an exchange?
lines.zh: 可以。您想退款还是换货？

lines.en: An exchange, if you have it in a medium.
lines.zh: 换一件吧，有 M 码吗？

lines.en: Let me check the stock. We have one in navy. Would you like to try it on?
lines.zh: 我查一下库存。有一件藏青色的。要试一下吗？

lines.en: Yes, please. Where's the fitting room?
lines.zh: 好的。试衣间在哪？

lines.en: Just over there. Take your time.
lines.zh: 就在那边。慢慢试。

lines.en: It fits well. I'll take this one, thanks for your help.
lines.zh: 挺合身，就这件吧，谢谢。

branch.task: 没有你要的尺码，选一个退路

prompt.en: We don't have it in a medium, only large.

react.en: It'd be here by Thursday. We do have one in navy, if you want to try the large.
react.zh: 周四能到。不过我们有件藏青的，您可以先试试大号。

say.en: I'll take the large, then, if it fits.
say.zh: 那就要大号吧，如果合身的话。

react.en: There's one in navy. Go ahead and try it.

phrases.en: Do you have it in a medium?
Would you like to try it on?

lines.en: Aisle four, on the left.
lines.zh: 四号通道，左手边。

lines.en: Thanks. And do you have eggs?
lines.zh: 谢谢。有鸡蛋吗？

lines.en: Yes, right next to the milk.
lines.zh: 有，就在牛奶旁边。

scenes.name: 手机店修电池 · 电池撑不到下午
scenes.setting: 手机用两年了，电池撑不到下午，你走进街角的维修店。

lines.en: Hi, are you looking for a new phone?
lines.zh: 你好，想买新手机吗？

lines.en: Just looking. My battery dies by noon.
lines.zh: 先看看。我电池到中午就没电了。
lines.note: dies 用在电池上是「没电了」，不是「死掉」。

lines.en: That sounds like a worn battery. We can replace it for forty.
lines.zh: 那像是电池老化了。换一块四十。

lines.en: Really? How long does it take?
lines.zh: 真的？要多久？

lines.en: About an hour. Or you could trade it in.
lines.zh: 大概一小时。也可以折价换新。

lines.en: What would a trade-in be worth?
lines.zh: 折价能值多少？
lines.note: trade in 是旧机折价，名词形式 trade-in。

lines.en: Around a hundred, depending on the condition.
lines.zh: 大概一百，看机况。

lines.en: I will do the battery first. Do I need an appointment?
lines.zh: 我先换电池吧。要预约吗？

lines.en: No, but there is a two-hour wait today.
lines.zh: 不用，但今天要等两小时。

branch.task: 对方说你的机型修不了，你要换个方案

prompt.en: Actually, your model is on the list we cannot open. The glass is glued to the frame.
prompt.zh: 其实你这个型号我们不能拆，玻璃是粘在框上的。

say.en: So what are my options?

react.en: Trade it in as is, or send it to the official service centre.
react.zh: 按现状折价，或者送官方售后。

say.en: How much would the official centre charge?

react.en: Around a hundred and twenty, and it takes a week.

phrases.zh: 我电池到中午就没电了。

phrases.en: What would a trade-in be worth?

lines.en: No problem. We are open till seven.

scenes.name: 手机店修电池 · 买二手
scenes.setting: 你想买一台二手手机，但不放心机况。

lines.en: Hi, are you looking for a new phone?
lines.zh: 你好，想买新手机吗？

lines.en: Do you sell refurbished phones?
lines.zh: 你们卖翻新机吗？
lines.note: dies 用在电池上是「没电了」，不是「死掉」。

lines.en: We do. They come with a one-year warranty.
lines.zh: 卖。带一年保修。

lines.en: Is the battery new in those?
lines.zh: 那些电池是新的吗？

lines.en: New in most of them. The label on the box tells you.
lines.zh: 大部分是新的。盒子上标签会写。

lines.en: What would a trade-in be worth?
lines.zh: 折价能值多少？
lines.note: trade in 是旧机折价，名词形式 trade-in。

lines.en: Around a hundred, depending on the condition.
lines.zh: 大概一百，看机况。

lines.en: I will look at the refurbished ones. Which shelf?
lines.zh: 我看看翻新机。在哪一排？

lines.en: Right behind you. Take your time.
lines.zh: 就在你后面。慢慢看。

scenes.name: 家具店量尺寸 · 窗下那块空地
scenes.setting: 你搬进新公寓，卧室只有窗下一块空地能放书桌。

lines.en: Can I help you find anything?
lines.zh: 需要帮您找什么吗？

lines.en: I am looking for a desk, something small.
lines.zh: 我想找一张书桌，小一点的。

lines.en: How wide is the space?
lines.zh: 空间有多宽？

lines.en: About a meter. It has to fit under the window.
lines.zh: 大概一米。得能塞进窗户下面。

lines.en: This one is ninety centimeters. It comes flat-packed.
lines.zh: 这张九十厘米。是平板包装的。
lines.note: flat-packed 是自己回家组装的平板包装，宜家那种。

lines.en: Do you deliver?
lines.zh: 你们送货吗？

lines.en: Yes, thirty for delivery, or free if you pick it up.
lines.zh: 送，三十块运费。自提免费。

lines.en: I will take it. Can I pay now and pick it up Saturday?
lines.zh: 我要了。能现在付、周六来取吗？

branch.task: 送货时间有变，你要调整安排

prompt.en: Delivery is thirty, but we cannot do Saturdays.
prompt.zh: 送货三十，但周六送不了。

say.en: A weekday evening, then?

react.en: Thursday after six works.

say.en: I will collect it myself.

react.en: Then it is free. Bring a friend, it is heavy.
react.zh: 那就免费。带个朋友来，挺沉的。

phrases.en: I am looking for a desk.

scenes.name: 菜市场买水果 · 周六早市
scenes.setting: 周六早市，你想买点能生吃的西红柿，摊主开价偏高。

lines.en: Tomatoes, two fifty a pound.
lines.zh: 西红柿，两块五一磅。

lines.en: That is a bit much. How about two?
lines.zh: 有点贵。两块行吗？

lines.en: Two twenty, and I will throw in an onion.
lines.zh: 两块二，再送你一个洋葱。
lines.note: throw in 是「白送、搭一个」，菜市场砍价的标准收尾。

lines.en: Deal. Two pounds, please.
lines.zh: 成交。来两磅。

lines.en: Anything else? The peaches came in this morning.
lines.zh: 还要别的吗？桃子今早到的。

lines.en: Are they sweet?
lines.zh: 甜吗？

lines.en: Very. Try a piece.
lines.zh: 很甜。尝一块。

lines.en: They are good. I will take four.
lines.zh: 不错。来四个。

branch.task: 对方不肯让价，你要决定买还是不买

prompt.en: Two fifty is already the early price. I cannot go lower.
prompt.zh: 两块五已经是早市价了，不能再低。

say.en: All right, two pounds then.

react.en: Good choice. Anything else?

say.en: I will look around first.

react.en: Suit yourself. I am here till noon.

phrases.en: I will throw in an onion.

scenes.name: 快递点寄退货 · 开箱就是裂的
scenes.setting: 网购的显示器开箱就裂了，你按客服说的来寄回去。

lines.en: Next, please. What are you sending?
lines.zh: 下一位。寄什么？

lines.en: I need to return this. The screen came cracked.
lines.zh: 我要退这个。屏幕到货就是裂的。
lines.note: 电商退货说 return，保修维修说 repair —— 两者流程完全不同。

lines.en: Do you have the return label?
lines.zh: 有退货面单吗？

lines.en: Yes, it is on my phone.
lines.zh: 有，在手机里。

lines.en: I need it printed. There is a printer by the door.
lines.zh: 得打印出来。门边有打印机。

lines.en: All right. Does it need to be boxed?
lines.zh: 好。需要装箱吗？

lines.en: Please. And keep the tracking slip.
lines.zh: 要装。还有，收好这张追踪单。

lines.en: Will the refund go through once it is scanned?
lines.zh: 他们一扫码就退款吗？

lines.en: Usually the same day it reaches the warehouse.
lines.zh: 一般到仓当天就退。

branch.task: 对方没有包装箱，你要临时解决

prompt.en: We have run out of boxes today.
prompt.zh: 今天我们箱子用完了。

say.en: Can I buy one next door?

react.en: The shop on the corner sells them for two pounds.

say.en: I will bring it back tomorrow in my own box.
say.zh: 我明天用自己箱子拿回来。

react.en: Fine. Keep the label, it stays valid for a week.
react.zh: 行。面单留着，一周内有效。

phrases.en: Do you have the return label?
Does it need to be boxed?

scenes.setting: 你上个月寄的包裹一直没到，单号也查不到。

lines.en: Next, please. What are you sending?
lines.zh: 下一位。寄什么？

lines.en: I sent a parcel three weeks ago and the tracking has not moved.
lines.zh: 我三周前寄了个包裹，物流一直没动。
lines.note: 电商退货说 return，保修维修说 repair —— 两者流程完全不同。

lines.en: Let me see the tracking number. If it is lost, we open a claim.
lines.zh: 给我看单号。如果丢了，我们提查件。

lines.en: Here it is. How long does a claim take?
lines.zh: 在这儿。查件要多久？

lines.en: About two weeks. If it turns up, we will call you.
lines.zh: 大概两周。要是找到了，我们会打给您。

lines.en: Thanks. That is all for today.
lines.zh: 谢谢。今天就这些。

lines.en: Sorry about the trouble.

scenes.name: 快递点寄退货 · 上门取件
scenes.setting: 你东西太大搬不动，想问能不能上门取。

lines.en: Next, please. What are you sending?
lines.zh: 下一位。寄什么？

lines.en: Do you do pickups? The box is too big for me to carry.
lines.zh: 你们上门取件吗？箱子太大我搬不动。

lines.en: We do, for five pounds. Book online before noon.
lines.zh: 可以，五镑。中午前在网上预约。

lines.en: Booked. Can they come tomorrow morning?
lines.zh: 约好了。他们能明天上午来吗？

lines.en: Morning slots go fast. Leave it at the door if you are out.
lines.zh: 上午的时段很抢手。你不在家就放门口。

lines.en: Should I box it before they come?
lines.zh: 他们来之前我要装箱吗？

lines.en: Please. And keep the tracking slip.
lines.zh: 要装。还有，收好这张追踪单。

lines.en: Will the refund go through once it is scanned?
lines.zh: 他们一扫码就退款吗？

lines.en: Usually the same day it reaches the warehouse.

lines.zh: 只包装就行。你们的退换政策是什么？

lines.en: Thirty days with the receipt, no questions asked.

scenes.setting: 同事搬了新家，办了个小型派对，你一个人来的。

lines.en: You made it! Come in.
lines.zh: 你来了！进来。

lines.en: Thanks for having me. What can I bring?
lines.zh: 谢谢邀请。我带点什么？
lines.note: Thanks for having me 是做客的标准开场，比 thanks for inviting 更自然。

lines.en: Nothing, you are already here. Drinks are in the kitchen.
lines.zh: 什么都不用，人来了就行。饮料在厨房。

lines.en: I brought some wine. Where should I put it?
lines.zh: 我带了瓶酒。放哪儿？

lines.en: On the table by the window. Have you met Sam?
lines.zh: 窗边那张桌子。你见过 Sam 吗？

lines.en: Not yet. Could you introduce us?
lines.zh: 还没有。能介绍一下吗？

lines.en: Sam, this is Wen. She just moved into the building.
lines.zh: Sam，这是 Wen。她刚搬进这栋楼。

lines.en: Nice to meet you. How do you know the host?
lines.zh: 很高兴认识你。你怎么认识主人的？

branch.task: 有人递给你一样你不想吃或不想喝的东西

say.en: I am driving tonight, so none for me.

react.en: Fair enough. There is plenty of soda.

lines.en: So how do you know Alex?

lines.en: We worked together two years ago. You?
lines.zh: 两年前一起工作过。你呢？

lines.en: That is either good or worrying.
lines.zh: 这要么是好事，要么挺让人担心。

lines.en: Not really. You can rent everything at the gym.

lines.en: We are having a few people over on Saturday. Would you like to come?
lines.zh: 周六我们家来几个人。你来吗？
lines.note: have people over 是「在家招待人」，比 invite to my home 自然。

lines.en: That sounds nice. What is the occasion?
lines.zh: 听着不错。什么 occasion？

lines.en: No occasion. Just dinner and a lot of talking.
lines.zh: 没什么 occasion。就是吃顿饭，聊聊天。

lines.en: Can I bring anything?
lines.zh: 要带什么吗？

lines.en: A dessert, if you like. Nothing else.
lines.zh: 愿意的话带个甜点。别的不用。

lines.en: What time should I come?
lines.zh: 我几点到？

lines.en: Seven, but come at seven thirty if you want to miss the chaos.
lines.zh: 七点，但想避开混乱就七点半来。

lines.en: Seven thirty it is. Should I bring my partner?
lines.zh: 那就七点半。要带我伴侣吗？

say.en: I will keep nuts off the menu entirely.
say.zh: 我菜单里完全不放坚果。

react.en: Then nobody has to worry.

say.en: I will label everything clearly.

react.en: That works too.

scenes.setting: 朋友临时约你周末出门，你已经累到不想动。

lines.en: We are going to the coast this weekend. Want to join?
lines.zh: 这周末我们去海边。一起来吗？

lines.en: That sounds great, but I have to work Saturday.
lines.zh: 听着很好，但我周六要上班。

lines.en: Sunday, then? We are staying one night.
lines.zh: 那周日呢？我们住一晚。

lines.en: I would love to, but I am already stretched thin this month.
lines.zh: 我很想去，但这个月我已经排满了。
lines.note: stretched thin 是「精力被摊得太薄」，比 I am busy 更具体也更诚恳。

lines.en: No worries. Another time.
lines.zh: 没事。下次。

lines.en: Definitely. Let me know when you go again.
lines.zh: 一定。你们再去的时候告诉我。

scenes.setting: 你和室友合住三个月，卫生一直靠自觉，现在不行了。

lines.en: Can we talk about the flat for a minute?
lines.zh: 能聊一下房子的事吗？

lines.en: Sure. Is something wrong?
lines.zh: 行。怎么了？

lines.en: The bins have not gone out for a week, and the kitchen is getting bad.
lines.zh: 垃圾一周没拿出去，厨房开始有味儿了。

lines.en: I thought you were doing bins this week.
lines.zh: 我以为这周你负责垃圾。

lines.en: We never actually agreed on that. That is the problem.
lines.zh: 我们其实没定过。问题就在这儿。

lines.en: Fair. Shall we write it down?
lines.zh: 有道理。写下来？

lines.en: Yes. Bins on Tuesday, bathroom on Sunday, and dishes daily.
lines.zh: 好。周二倒垃圾，周日打扫浴室，碗每天洗。

lines.en: Deal. I will put it on the fridge.
lines.zh: 成交。我贴冰箱上。

react.en: Then I owe you two weeks of bins.

say.en: Fine, but let us write the rest down too.

react.en: Agreed. Fridge, tonight.

lines.en: Sorry, are you using this bench?
lines.zh: 不好意思，你用这张凳吗？

lines.en: All yours. I am done with it.
lines.zh: 你用吧。我用完了。

lines.en: Thanks. Do you know if the squat rack is free?
lines.zh: 谢谢。你知道深蹲架空着吗？

lines.en: Someone is on it, but he is nearly finished.
lines.zh: 有人在用，但快结束了。

lines.en: I will wait. How often do you come here?
lines.zh: 我等会儿。你多久来一次？

lines.en: Three mornings a week. It is quiet at this hour.
lines.zh: 一周三个早上。这个点人少。

lines.en: That is why I switched. Evenings are impossible.
lines.zh: 所以我才改时间。晚上根本挤不进去。

lines.en: Tell me about it. Good luck with the rack.
lines.zh: 可不是。祝你抢到架子。

scenes.setting: 同事请假一周后回来上班，你想说点什么又怕说错。

lines.en: I heard about your father. I am so sorry.
lines.zh: 我听说了你父亲的事。真的很难过。
lines.note: I am so sorry 在吊唁里是标准说法，不是道歉。

lines.en: Thank you. It was sudden.
lines.zh: 谢谢。很突然。

lines.en: I cannot imagine. How are you holding up?
lines.zh: 我难以想象。你还撑得住吗？

lines.en: Some days are fine. Some are not.
lines.zh: 有些天还好。有些天不行。

lines.en: That sounds about right. Is there anything I can take off your plate?

lines.note: take something off your plate 是「替你分担工作」。

lines.en: The Friday report, if you could cover it once.
lines.zh: 周五那份报告，能帮我顶一次吗？

lines.en: Consider it done. Do not think about it again.
lines.zh: 交给我。别再想它了。

lines.en: That means more than you know.
lines.zh: 这比你知道的更重要。

scenes.name: 街头问路 · 找药店
scenes.setting: 你在陌生城市找一家药店，手机没电了，只能问人。

lines.en: Excuse me, sorry to bother you. Is there a pharmacy near here?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，不好意思。附近有药店吗？
lines.note: sorry to bother you 是开口第一句的缓冲垫，不说这句直接问会显得突兀。

lines.en: Sure. Go straight down this street and take the second left.
lines.zh: 有。沿这条街一直走，第二个路口左转。

lines.en: The second left. Is it far?
lines.zh: 第二个路口左转。远吗？

lines.en: Not at all, about five minutes on foot. It's next to the bank.
lines.zh: 不远，走路大概五分钟。就在银行旁边。
lines.note: on foot＝步行。走路五分钟说 five minutes on foot，不说 by walk。

lines.en: Great. Is it open on Sundays?
lines.zh: 好。周日开门吗？

lines.en: I think so, until six. If it's closed, there's another one by the station.
lines.zh: 应该开，到六点。要是关了，车站那边还有一家。

lines.en: That's really helpful. Thank you so much.
lines.zh: 帮了大忙，太谢谢了。

lines.en: No problem. Have a good one!
lines.zh: 不客气，过得愉快！
lines.note: Have a good one 是美式口语告别，比 Have a nice day 更随意。

scenes.name: 打车去机场 · 赶飞机
scenes.setting: 你出门晚了，离登机只剩一个半小时，拦下一辆出租。

lines.en: Hi, are you free?
lines.zh: 你好，空车吗？

lines.en: Where to?
lines.zh: 去哪儿？

lines.en: The airport, Terminal 2.
lines.zh: 机场，二号航站楼。

lines.en: That is about forty minutes with this traffic.
lines.zh: 这个点堵，大概四十分钟。

lines.en: That is fine. Could you take the motorway?
lines.zh: 行。能走高速吗？

lines.en: Sure, it is faster, but there is a toll.
lines.zh: 可以，快一些，但要过路费。

lines.en: No problem. Roughly how much will it be?
lines.zh: 没问题。大概多少钱？
lines.note: roughly 是「大概」，打车问价先说 roughly，司机不会觉得你在压价。

lines.en: Around thirty-five, plus the toll.
lines.zh: 三十五左右，过路费另算。

lines.en: Good. Can I pay by card?
lines.zh: 好。能刷卡吗？

lines.en: Yes, the machine takes cards.
lines.zh: 能，机器支持刷卡。

branch.task: 对方报的价比你预期高，你要决定接受还是换方案

prompt.en: With the toll it will be nearer fifty. Still want the motorway?
prompt.zh: 加过路费差不多五十。还是走高速吗？

say.en: Fine, I am in a hurry.

react.en: Then the motorway it is.

say.en: Take the normal road, then. I have time.
say.zh: 那走普通路吧，我有时间。

react.en: Your call. It will be slower but cheaper.

phrases.en: Roughly how much will it be?

lines.en: Hi, I have a booking under Chen.
lines.zh: 你好，我用陈的名字订了车。

lines.en: Found it. Compact, three days. Licence and card, please.
lines.zh: 找到了。紧凑型，三天。驾照和卡。

lines.en: Here they are. Is insurance included?
lines.zh: 都在这儿。含保险吗？

lines.en: Basic is. Full cover is twelve a day.
lines.zh: 基本险含。全险一天十二。

lines.en: I will take the full cover.
lines.zh: 那我要全险。

lines.en: Good choice. The car is in bay seven.
lines.zh: 明智。车在七号位。

lines.en: Does it come with a full tank?

lines.en: Full to full. Bring it back full or we charge for the fuel.
lines.zh: 满油取满油还。还车不满要收油费。

lines.en: Understood. Is there a number for breakdowns?
lines.zh: 明白。有救援电话吗？

lines.en: It is on the key tag.
lines.zh: 钥匙牌上就有。

lines.zh: 大约三小时，天气原因。

lines.en: Will I still make my connection?
lines.zh: 我还赶得上转机吗？

lines.en: It will be tight. Come to the desk and we will rebook you.

lines.zh: 那就候补吧。餐券呢？

lines.zh: 这张十五的。给您添麻烦了。

lines.en: Thanks. Where do I wait for the waitlist call?

scenes.name: 求职面试 · 前端第三轮
scenes.setting: 你面试一家做产品的公司，岗位是前端工程师，聊到第三轮。

lines.en: Thanks for coming in. Tell me a little about yourself.
lines.zh: 谢谢你来。简单介绍一下自己吧。

lines.en: I've been working as a front-end developer for three years, mostly on internal tools.
lines.zh: 我做前端开发三年了，主要做内部工具。
lines.note: 「做了三年」用 I've been working，不用 I work，否则听起来像一直在同一状态。

lines.en: What made you want to apply here?
lines.zh: 为什么想来我们这儿？

lines.en: I've followed your product for a while, and I'd like to work on something more user-facing.
lines.zh: 我关注你们产品有一阵了，想做一些更贴近用户的东西。

lines.en: What would you say is your biggest weakness?
lines.zh: 你觉得你最大的不足是什么？

lines.en: I tend to take on too much on my own. I've started asking for help earlier, but it's still a work in progress.
lines.zh: 我容易一个人扛太多。现在会早点开口求助，但还在改。
lines.note: a work in progress＝还在改进中。谈缺点时的体面收尾，不等于是借口。

lines.en: And how do you handle tight deadlines?
lines.zh: 遇到很紧的截止日期怎么处理？

lines.en: I break the work down and flag risks early, rather than hoping it'll be fine.
lines.zh: 我会把活拆开、尽早把风险讲出来，而不是指望最后没事。

lines.en: Good. Do you have any questions for us?
lines.zh: 好。你有什么想问我们的吗？

lines.en: Yes, what does success look like in this role in the first six months?
lines.zh: 有，这个岗位头半年做到什么样算成功？
lines.note: 反问环节最加分的一句：What does success look like…

branch.task: 对方说你的回答太笼统，要给一个具体例子

prompt.en: That's a bit vague. Could you give me an example?
prompt.zh: 这有点笼统。能举个例子吗？

say.en: Sure. Last quarter I took on two projects and missed a deadline.
say.zh: 好。上季度我同时接了两个项目，结果误了一个期限。

react.en: Thanks for being specific. And how do you handle tight deadlines?
react.zh: 谢谢，很具体。那你怎么应对很紧的期限？

say.en: Honestly, that's the hardest question. Let me think for a second.
say.zh: 说实话这个最难答，让我想一下。

react.en: No problem. Whenever you're ready. And how do you handle tight deadlines?
react.zh: 没关系，想好了再说。那你怎么应对很紧的期限？

phrases.en: Tell me a little about yourself.
I've been working as a … for three years.
It's still a work in progress.
What does success look like in this role?
phrases.zh: 这个岗位做到什么样算成功？

scenes.name: 客服电话 · 物流停更
scenes.setting: 你十天前订的显示器还没到，物流页面停在上周四。你打了客服。

lines.en: Thank you for calling. How may I assist you today?
lines.zh: 感谢来电，请问有什么可以帮您？

lines.en: Hi, I ordered a monitor ten days ago and it still hasn't arrived.
lines.zh: 你好，我十天前订了一台显示器，到现在还没到。

lines.en: I'm sorry about that. Could I have your order number?
lines.zh: 很抱歉。可以给我订单号吗？

lines.en: It's 88214. The tracking page hasn't updated since last Thursday.
lines.zh: 88214。物流页面从上周四就没更新过。
lines.note: since + 时间点，配现在完成时。这是电话里说清问题的关键结构。

lines.en: I see the parcel is stuck at the depot. I'll open a claim with the courier.
lines.zh: 我看到包裹卡在站点。我向快递公司提个查件。

lines.en: How long will that take? I need it for work.
lines.zh: 要多久？我工作要用。

lines.en: Two to three business days. If it isn't found by then, we'll send a replacement.
lines.zh: 两到三个工作日。如果那时还没找到，我们补发一台。

lines.en: Could you email me once there's an update?
lines.zh: 有进展能发邮件告诉我吗？

lines.en: Of course. I've noted that on your account. Is there anything else?
lines.zh: 当然，我在您账户上备注了。还有其他事吗？

lines.en: No, that's all. Thanks for your help.
lines.zh: 没有了，谢谢。

react.en: It looks like a payment issue. I'll open a claim with that team.
react.zh: 看起来是支付问题。我向那边提个查件。

say.en: Could you place the order again for me?

react.en: I can do that now, at the same price. I'll mark it urgent.
react.zh: 现在就能下，价格不变。我标成加急。

scenes.name: 每日站会 · 服务器挂了
scenes.setting: 早上十点站会，你已经卡了两天。

lines.en: Morning. Anything blocking you?
lines.zh: 早。有卡住的地方吗？

lines.en: Yesterday I finished the login flow. Today I am on the API errors.
lines.zh: 昨天我做完了登录流程。今天在处理接口报错。

lines.en: Any blockers?
lines.zh: 有阻塞吗？

lines.en: The staging server is down, so I cannot test.
lines.zh: 测试服务器挂了，我没法测。

lines.en: I will ping ops. Anything else?

lines.zh: 还有一件。做设置页之前我需要设计评审。

lines.en: I will book thirty minutes with Mina this afternoon.
lines.zh: 我下午跟 Mina 约三十分钟。

lines.en: Perfect. That unblocks me for the rest of the week.
lines.zh: 太好了。这周剩下的就顺了。

scenes.name: 茶水间遇到同事 · 周一茶水间
scenes.setting: 周一早上，你在茶水间接咖啡，同事也进来了。

lines.en: Hey, how was the weekend?
lines.zh: 嘿，周末怎么样？

lines.en: Quiet. I finally finished a book I started in March.
lines.zh: 挺安静。三月开始的书终于看完了。

lines.en: Nice. I meant to rest and ended up painting the flat.
lines.zh: 不错。我本来想休息，结果刷了一天墙。

lines.en: That sounds like work, not rest.
lines.zh: 那听着像干活，不像休息。

lines.en: It was. Are you coming to the team lunch on Thursday?
lines.zh: 确实是。周四团队午餐你来吗？

lines.en: I did not know about it. Where is it?
lines.zh: 我不知道有这事。在哪儿？

lines.en: The Thai place round the corner. Twelve thirty.
lines.zh: 拐角那家泰国菜。十二点半。

lines.en: Count me in. Should I bring anything?
lines.zh: 算我一个。要带什么吗？

scenes.name: 离职交接 · 接手计费服务
scenes.setting: 同事下周离职，你要接手他维护了三年的服务。

lines.en: Thanks for taking this over. Where do you want to start?
lines.zh: 谢谢你接手。你想从哪儿开始？

lines.en: The billing service. I have never touched it.
lines.zh: 计费服务。我从没碰过。

lines.en: It has three parts. The docs cover two of them.
lines.zh: 它有三部分。文档覆盖了两部分。

lines.en: Which one is not documented?
lines.zh: 哪部分没写文档？

lines.en: The nightly job. Only two people understand it, and one is leaving.
lines.zh: 夜间任务。只有两个人懂，其中一个要走了。

lines.en: That is me now. Can we go through it together?
lines.zh: 现在就是我了。能一起过一遍吗？

lines.en: I blocked two hours tomorrow. Bring questions.
lines.zh: 我明天留了两小时。带上问题来。

lines.en: I will. And who do I ask when something breaks at night?
lines.zh: 好。夜里出问题我问谁？

lines.en: The on-call rota is in the wiki. Start with the platform team.
lines.zh: 值班表在 wiki 上。先找平台组。

branch.task: 对方把问题推回给你，你要给出可执行的答案

prompt.en: Then I am the only one left. What if it breaks in my first week?
prompt.zh: 那我是唯一剩下的人了。第一周就出问题怎么办？

say.en: Call me. I will answer for the first month.
say.zh: 打给我。第一个月我都会接。

react.en: That takes a lot off my mind.

say.en: We write a runbook together before Friday.
say.zh: 周五前我们一起写份操作手册。

react.en: Two hours, then. I will book a room.
react.zh: 那两小时。我订个会议室。

phrases.en: Where do you want to start?
It is a year out of date.

scenes.name: 接客户投诉 · 报告迟到
scenes.setting: 客户在电话里语气很硬，董事会要用这份报告。

lines.en: We have been waiting three weeks for the report.
lines.zh: 那份报告我们等了三周。

lines.en: I understand, and I am sorry. Let me tell you where it stands.
lines.zh: 我理解，也很抱歉。我说一下现在的情况。

lines.en: Where it stands is that my board meeting is on Monday.
lines.zh: 现在的情况是，我周一的董事会。

lines.en: You will have it Friday. I will send a draft Thursday for your comments.
lines.zh: 周五会给您。周四我先发一版草稿给您好提意见。

lines.en: Friday is cutting it close. Why was it late?
lines.zh: 周五太紧了。为什么会晚？

lines.en: Two of the numbers came in late from your finance team.
lines.zh: 有两个数字你们财务给晚了。

lines.en: Nobody told me that.
lines.zh: 没人告诉我这件事。

lines.en: That is on us. I should have flagged it two weeks ago.
lines.zh: 这是我们的问题。我两周前就该提出来。

lines.en: All right. Friday, and I want the draft Thursday.
lines.zh: 行。周五，还有周四要看到草稿。

branch.task: 客户逼你给一个承诺，你要给得既确定又留余地

prompt.en: Can you promise it will be on my desk Friday morning?

react.en: Noon Friday. I will hold you to that.

say.en: I can promise Thursday night, not Friday morning.
say.zh: 我能保证周四晚上，不是周五上午。

react.en: Then Thursday night it is.

scenes.name: 跟主管谈加薪 · 范围变大薪资没变
scenes.setting: 你接手了离职同事的全部工作，半年没有调薪。

lines.en: Do you have twenty minutes? I would like to talk about my role.
lines.zh: 你有二十分钟吗？我想聊聊我的岗位。

lines.en: Sure, sit down. What is on your mind?
lines.zh: 当然，坐。什么事？

lines.en: I have taken on the billing service and two new clients this year.
lines.zh: 今年我接了计费服务，还带了两个新客户。

lines.en: You have. The team is smaller than it was.
lines.zh: 是的。团队比之前小了。

lines.en: My scope has grown, but my title and pay have not changed.
lines.zh: 我的范围扩大了，但职级和薪资没变。

lines.en: What are you asking for?
lines.zh: 你想要什么？

lines.en: A review of my band, and a title that matches the work.
lines.zh: 重新评估我的职级带宽，还有匹配工作的头衔。
lines.note: band 是薪资带宽，谈薪时说 band 比说 money 专业。

lines.en: I cannot promise a number today. Can I come back to you next week?
lines.zh: 我今天给不了具体数字。下周回复你可以吗？

lines.en: That is fair. I will send you the list of what I have taken on.
lines.zh: 可以。我把接手的事情列一份发你。

branch.task: 对方要你把要求量化，你要给出可比较的依据

prompt.en: Give me a number. What do you think you should be on?
prompt.zh: 给我个数。你觉得应该是多少？

say.en: The market range for this scope is ten to fifteen percent above mine.
say.zh: 这个范围的市场价比我高百分之十到十五。

react.en: Let me check that against our bands.
react.zh: 我拿这个跟我们的带宽对一下。

say.en: I would rather hear your range first.
say.zh: 我更想先听你们的范围。

react.en: Fair enough. I will bring it next week.

phrases.en: My scope has grown, but my pay has not.
phrases.zh: 我的范围扩大了，薪资没变。

phrases.en: What would make it a yes in six months?
phrases.zh: 半年后做到什么才能批？
